patterns.title: Header-derived, length-bounded payload parser
patterns.property: parse_deplen_data_t refines (h,payload) with U32.v(dlf h) == Seq.length(serialize ps payload). parse_deplen_unfold2 characterizes the parser as header parsing followed by an exact, header-sized payload slice; parsing succeeds only if the payload parser and serializer both agree on that length.

source_proof_check.scope: Upstream F* check of the LowParse target; selected modules are identified in the job log.
source_proof_check.admission_review: The full selected job log contains neither ADMIT=1 nor --admit_smt_queries true. A distinct job with those admission flags is retained as compilation-only evidence.

trace.property: The header-derived length equals the serialized payload length.

trace.obligation: parse_deplen is built from the header parser and a payload parser refined by the header tag.

The parse_deplen_unfold2 lemma rejects an incomplete frame, parses exactly the advertised payload slice, requires exact payload consumption and serializer length, and returns the total consumed offset.

trace.implementation: The Pulse validator calls the unfolding lemma, bounds the payload length against remaining input, splits at payload_end, validates on the bounded slice, and succeeds only when the cursor reaches payload_end; failures restore the incoming cursor.

trace.related_contract: The serializer unfolds to serialized header bytes concatenated with serialized payload bytes.

trace.interface: A parser returns an optional value and a consumed length bounded by input length; parser specs forbid lookahead past the returned offset.

patterns.use_case: Use when a wire-format header selects the exact byte extent of a following payload and an implementation must reject truncation or a parser that consumes a different length.
